Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

sale — a period of lower prices. Example: There is a sale this week.
discount — a reduction in price. Example: There is a discount of twenty per cent.
offer — a special lower price. Example: It is a special offer.
cheap — not expensive. Example: This phone is cheaper than last week.
expensive — costing a lot of money. Example: That jacket is expensive.
deal — a good price for something. Example: It is a good deal.
buy — to get something with money. Example: I want to buy this phone.
price — how much something costs. Example: The price is good.
shop — a place where you buy things. Example: Every shop has a discount.
crowd — a lot of people together. Example: There is a big crowd in the shop.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• There is a big discount.
• It is cheaper than ...
• It is a good deal.
• The shops are full.
• It is the best price.
